title: Machhali Palan (MPUK)
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to fishermen for repairing, reconstructing, and replacing damaged boats and nets due to disasters.

title: Flexible Memorandum of Understanding (Flexi-MoU) Scheme (FLEXI-MOU)
provider: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
summary: The scheme is designed to cater to the needs of both industry as well as trainees. The scheme allows industries to train candidates as per their skill set requirements and provides trainees with an industry environment aligned with the market demand and latest technology to undergo training.

title: Financial Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (FLFTCP)
summary: The scheme aims to support students from Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) in obtaining Commercial Pilot License (CPL) training through financial assistance. Under this scheme, a loan of up to ₹25,00,000 is offered at a concessional interest rate of 4% per annum to the students.....

title: Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)
summary: “Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)” by the Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal aims to facilitate end-to-end (from land development to residue management) use of farm machinery which can be within the reach of the small and marginal farmers at reasonable charges.

title: Fruit Processing Centre (FPC)
summary: The objective of scheme is to disseminate technical knowhow to youth entrepreneurs, farmers & housewives through practical demonstration on importance of fruit preservation & to manufacture quality processed fruit products such as Squashes, Jams, Jelly & Juices under trade name ‘Meg Fruits Product'.

title: Food Processing and Value Addition Management (FPVAM)
summary: The scheme aims to promote the establishment of food processing units in Uttarakhand, enhance value addition in agricultural and horticultural products, support entrepreneurs with financial assistance, and strengthen the state’s food processing ecosystem.

title: Foreign Study Loan (FSL)
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from non-reserved categories for pursuing higher studies abroad in medical and post-graduation courses. It offers loans up to ₹15,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum to eligible students.

title: Futkar Sabji, Phal-Phool Vikreta Hetu Taraju, Baat Evan Tokari Sahaayata Yojana (FSPPV)
summary: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Futkar Sabji, Phal-Phool Vikreta Hetu Taraju, Baat Evan Tokari Sahaayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 15 June 2016.

title: Free Training for Vehicle Drivers (FTVD)
summary: The scheme aims to improve the driving skills and employability of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates by providing free, high-quality driving training, thereby reducing road accidents and promoting self-employment opportunities.

title: Green Business Scheme (GBS)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: Green Business Scheme has been launched by the National Safai Karamcharis Finance and Development Corporation to provide financial assistance in the form of loans for activities that can tackle the impacts of climate change and also be income-generating.

title: Green Business Scheme - Haryana (GBSHR)
summary: Under this scheme, loans of up to ₹2.00 lakhs are provided to Scheduled Caste residents of Haryana for undertaking income-generating activities that help mitigate the greenhouse effect, such as e-rickshaws, compressed air vehicles, solar energy gadgets, polyhouses, and similar eco-friendly ventures.

title: "Grant to Coir Cluster/Societies/Agency" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme (GCCSA-DC)
summary: The "Grant to Coir Cluster/Societies/Agency" scheme aims to foster the development of coir industries. The scheme encourages unemployed rural youth and artisan individuals to participate in the manufacturing and sales of coir products. Grant of ₹2,00,000 per year is provided for five years.

title: Grid Connected Rooftop Solar Power Plant Scheme - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (GCRSPPSUREDA)
summary: The scheme aims to promote the adoption of rooftop solar energy among domestic consumers in Uttarakhand by providing financial support and enabling them to generate clean, renewable electricity, reduce their electricity bills through net metering.

title: Grid Connected Rooftop Scheme (Phase-II) - Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (GCRSUREDA)
summary: The scheme aims to promote the installation of rooftop solar systems among domestic households, group housing societies, and residential welfare associations in Uttarakhand, enabling consumers to reduce their electricity bills, earn income by feeding surplus power into the grid.

title: "Green and Eco-Friendly Measures" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises” (GEFM-MESIFAI-SA-MSME)
summary: The award for "Green and Eco-Friendly Measures" is conferred upon the industries that are green and eco-friendly as per the standards of the Department of Science, Technology and Environment (DSTE), Puducherry. The awardee is given a cash award of ₹2,00,000/- and a citation.

title: GEN-NEXT Support for Innovative Startups (GENESIS)
provider: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: The scheme aims to discover, support, grow, and accelerate successful startups in Tier-2 and Tier-3 cities, with a focus on inclusivity, accessibility, and affordability.

title: Government Food Science Training Centre (GFSTCUK)
summary: The scheme aims to provide specialized education and skill development in food processing, canning, bakery, confectionery, and cookery to students from Uttarakhand, empowering them with technical knowledge and practical expertise to pursue careers in the food industry and promote entrepreneurship.

title: "Grant To Handicrafts Societies" Component of the "Development of Handicrafts" Scheme (GHS-PUDU)
summary: “Grant To Handicrafts Societies” by the Department of Industries and Commerce, UT of Puducherry aims to encourage the creation of Handicrafts Societies to enhance coordination and skill among craftspeople. Grants are provided to registered societies for organizing or participating in exhibitions.

title: 'Grant-in-Aid to Industrial Association, CII, Industrial NGOs for Promotion of SME Clusters' under 'Marketing And Publicity' (GIAIACINPSC)
summary: Through this scheme, financial assistance is provided to the Industrial Associations, CII, and Industrial NGOs for the promotion of the SME Cluster. The financial assistance is 75% of the actual cost, subject to a maximum of ₹3,00,000/- per unit in cluster.

title: Grant-in-Aid Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Mahila Mandals (GIASPFAMM)
summary: "Grant-in-Aid Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance to the Mahila Mandals" aims to provide financial assistance to Mahila Mandals for training and self-employment activities. The scheme benefits registered Mahila Mandals in Goa, encouraging women's socio-economic development.

title: Grant-in-Aid Scheme To Provide Financial Assistance To The Mahila Mandals/ Women’s Self-help Groups (SWAWLAMBHAN) (GIASPFAMMWSHG)
summary: The SWAWLAMBHAN Scheme by the Govt. of Goa provides financial assistance to Mahila Mandals/Self-Help Groups for training/orientation for members of the Mahila Mandal/Self-Help Groups for generating their own activity for self-employment.

title: Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme (GICEIS)
summary: “Grant for Incubation Centers within Educational Institutes Scheme” is for the educational institutes in Goa, affiliated with a recognized public university. They can avail of a one-time grant towards capital expenses for setting up an incubator within their institute campuses.

title: Gadiya Lohar Raw Material Purchase Grant-in-aid Scheme (GLRMPGS)
summary: Under this scheme, the state government provides financial assistance of ₹10,000/- as a one-time grant to the Gadia Lohar community of Rajasthan for purchasing raw materials and making themselves self-reliant in their business.

title: "Grant of Margin Money for Availing Capital Loan" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme (GMMACL-DC)
summary: The scheme "Grant of Margin Money for Availing Capital Loan" aims to incentivize entrepreneurs to establish new coir industries & revitalise existing ones. The units must be set up in Puducherry. The scheme provides margin money upon receipt of a financial institution's sanction order for a project.

title: "Grant of Margin Money for Availing the Capital Loan" Component of the "Development of Silk" Scheme (GMMACL-DS)
summary: The scheme aims to encourage the entrepreneur to set up Silk Weaving Units in Puducherry. This margin money grants will reduce the initial financial burden on the entrepreneurs while availing term loan/working capital loan from the financial institutions for setting up of silk weaving units.

title: AICTE Grant for Organizing Conference (GOC)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to institutions for organizing conferences in various fields of science and technology, management, and hotel management, including BBA, BCA and BMS institutions.

title: Grants Provisioned under Uttarakhand Tourism Policy, 2023 (GPUTPUK)
summary: The aims to promote sustainable tourism development in the state by encouraging private and institutional investment in the tourism sector through targeted financial incentives and subsidies.

title: Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges (GQCRC)
summary: "Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges"reimburses payments made to Consultancy and certification agencies towards acquiring such Quality Certification subject to a ceiling of ₹ 2,00,000/- for National level certification and ₹ 10,00,000/- for International level Certification.

title: "Generator Subsidy" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries" (GS-MESIFAI)
summary: Through this scheme, the micro, small and medium industrial units (manufacturing and service sector) shall be eligible for the grant of 50% subsidy with a cap of ₹5,00,000/- per industrial unit on the investment made on or after 5-3-2009 on generator sets. The applications are accepted offline.

title: "Generator Subsidy" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - Various Incentives" (GS-MESIFAI-VI)
summary: Through the "Generator Subsidy" scheme, 50% subsidy is provided to the industrial units of the micro, small, medium and large industries for the purchase and installation of generators. The applications are accepted offline in the prescribed form available on the Official Website of the Department.

title: Generator Subsidy (GS-TN)
summary: The scheme "Generator Subsidy" is introduced with the objective of assisting all new and existing Micro, Small, and Medium Manufacturing Enterprises through a subsidy of 25% on the cost of the generator purchased (up to 320 KVA capacity), subject to a maximum of ₹ 5,00,000.

title: Gatidhara Scheme (GS-WEST BENGAL)
summary: The scheme “Gatidhara Scheme” was launched by the Transport Department, Government of West Bengal in August 2014 for employment of registered unemployed youth of the State in the transport sector.

title: Goa State 25% Subsidy for Self Employed Scheme (GS2SSES)
summary: The scheme aims to boost self-employment in Goa and subsidize Capital Investment to encourage the creation of fixed assets. The scheme provides a 25% subsidy on fixed capital investment to individuals, partnership firms, or groups of individuals who have availed loans for approved self-employment.

title: Guruji Student Credit Card (GSCC) Scheme (GSCCS)
summary: Under this scheme, a financial support initiative by the Jharkhand Government to help students pursue higher education without financial constraints. Under this scheme, eligible students can avail of education loans up to ₹15,00,000 at a subsidized 4% simple interest rate, with additional benefits.

title: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme (GSCIMS)
summary: The scheme aims to encourage Goan artisans to continue traditional clay idol making by providing a subsidy of ₹100/- per idol, supporting registered local craftsmen in preserving cultural heritage and ensuring livelihood sustainability.

title: Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP) (GSDPUK)
summary: The scheme "Harit Kaushal Vikas Karyakram" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), aims to impart eco-based livelihood skills to youth and communities in the Himalayan regions.

title: Goa State Export Market Development Scheme, 2008 (GSEMDS)
summary: The scheme "Goa State Export Market Development Scheme" encouraged Goan industries to improve export markets and support them in establishing their goods firmly in the export market. It provided interest-free loans up to ₹5,00,000/- for participating in exhibitions and market study tours abroad.

title: Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008 (GSESSI)
summary: "Goa State Employment Subsidy Scheme for the Industries, 2008" aimed to promote industrial growth, revive sick units, and provide employment to local youths. Additional subsidies and incentives were given to eligible manufacturing units, with a focus on local employment and industrial development.

title: Goa State Financial Incentives to the Industries for Certification and Patenting Scheme, 2008 (GSFIICPS)
summary: "Goa State Financial Incentives to the Industries for Certification and Patenting Scheme" aimed to encourage industrial units to obtain certifications and patents for quality standards. It provided financial assistance up to ₹2,00,000/- to eligible industries and service sectors.

title: Group Supply Of Goats And Sheep (GSGOS)
summary: Group supply of goats and sheep refers to the practice of selling or distributing goats and sheep in groups, rather than as individual animals. In Maharashtra, this practice is common among farmers, livestock traders, and cooperative organizations.

title: Grant of Subsidy For Setting up of Ice-Plant /Cold Storage/Fish Processing Unit (GSIS-ICFSFPU)
summary: This scheme aims to preserve fish and fishery products by facilitating the establishment of Ice Plant-cum-Cold Storage Units and Fish Processing Units. Through this scheme, eligible beneficiaries can avail a 10% subsidy.

title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Investment of Fixed Capital (GSLWI-SIFC)
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for developing the logistics and warehousing industry in Goa. It offers a capital subsidy of 10% or 15% (up to ₹50,00,000/- yearly) towards fixed asset investment for eligible logistics and warehousing entities.

title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Electricity Duty (GSLWIS-SED)
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for the development of the logistics and warehousing industry in the State. This component offers a 100% annual reimbursement of electricity duty, up to a maximum of ₹5,00,000/-, to eligible Cold Chain Units.

title: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Charges (GSLWIS-SSDRC)
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance by reimbursing Stamp Duty and Registration Charges paid by prospective developers engaged in the establishment of Logistics and Warehousing projects. The scheme provides 100% reimbursement, capped at ₹10,00,000/- for Stamp Duty.

title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Annual Interest Rate Payable On Loans (GSLWIS-STAIRPL)
summary: The subsidy aims to support the logistics and warehousing sector by reimbursing 50% of the annual interest paid on construction loans. The benefit is capped at ₹25,00,000/- (Indian Rupees Twenty-five Lakhs) annually per project and is available for up to 05 consecutive years for eligible entities.

title: Goa State Logistics And Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy Towards Skill Development (GSLWIS-STSD)
summary: The scheme provides reimbursement of 50% of the cost incurred for skill upgradation and training manpower, limited to a maximum of ₹5,000/- per person employed in the Entity. The scheme is implemented by the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce (DITC).

title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Quality (GSLWIS-STUQ)
summary: The scheme aims to support environmentally sustainable industrial development while accelerating investment in Goa. The scheme provides a one-time reimbursement equal to 50% of the expenses incurred for establishing a Quality Management System, capped at ₹5,00,000/- per Entity.

title: Goa State Logistics and Warehousing Incentives Scheme: Subsidy towards Upgradation in Logistics Management Software (GSLWIS-SULMS)
summary: The scheme aims to enhance operational efficiency in logistics and warehousing by subsidizing the cost of purchasing and installing Logistics Management Software. Eligible entities can receive a one-time reimbursement of 50% of the expenditure, capped at ₹2,00,000/- per installation.

title: "Grant to Subsidy for Raw Materials Procurement" Component of the "Development of Coir" Scheme (GSRMP-DC)
summary: The "Grant to Subsidy for Raw Materials Procurement" Scheme by the Department of Industries and Commerce, Union Territory of Puducherry, aims to promote Coir Industries by providing a 15% subsidy on annual raw materials procurement, capped at ₹5,00,000 per annum per unit.

title: "Grant to Silk Societies/Agency" Component of the "Development of Silk" Scheme (GSSA-DS)
summary: The scheme "Grant to Silk Societies/Agency" aims to encourage the silk weaving artisans to form registered societies/agencies to develop a cluster approach among the artisans which is effective and advisable at present for the successful development of their business.

title: Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme (GSWJWS)
summary: "Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme" aims to improve the welfare of working journalists retired from service in Goa and their families. It provides a monthly welfare fund of ₹ 7,500/- and family pension benefits for eligible journalists and their dependents.

title: Goa (Technical/ Vocational Training To Sex Workers And Sexually Abused Women) Scheme, 2013 (PRABHAT) (GTVTSWSAWWWS)
summary: The scheme provides technical/vocational training for sex workers and sexually abused women to enable them to earn for their livelihood through such technical/vocational training and skill. The department will take the assistance of members of reputed NGOs/Trust/Society/professionals/expert bodies.

title: Gramodhyog Vikas Kendra (GVK)
summary: The scheme aims to provide infrastructure facilities at village level to artisans through Common Facility Centers. Registered Non-Governmental Organizations, cooperative societies and trusts receive financial assistance up to ₹13,00,000/- for building infrastructure, training, equipment, etc.

title: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Gramodyog Vikas Yojana (KGVYGVY)
provider: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

title: GROUP WORKSHED SCHEME (GWS)
summary: The objective of the scheme is to facilitate the establishment of worksheds for shuttleless looms in an existing or new cluster, which will provide the required scale of economy for business operations.

title: House Building Loan Scheme for Employees of Government of Goa (HBLSEGG)
summary: The scheme aims to assist government employees in achieving their dream of owning a house by providing financial support to erstwhile House Building Advance scheme beneficiaries whose loans were operative as on 15th May 2020. The scheme provides loan takeover facility through empanelled banks.

title: Handicrafts Export Award (HEA)
summary: The "Handicrafts Export Award" scheme was launched by the Handlooms, Handicrafts, Textiles, and Khadi Dept, Government of Tamil Nadu. This award is given to encourage the exporters of handicraft items with a cash prize of ₹40,000/-, 4 gm gold medal, thamirapattiram & a certificate.

title: HIMAYAT- Deen Dayal Upadhyaya-Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
summary: HIMAYAT is a placement-linked placement-linked market-driven skill training program by the Ministry of Rural Development for the unemployed youth of J&K. The scheme aims at providing entrepreneurial skills for sustainable livelihood to 30,000 youth of J&K and facilitating access to finance.

title: Him Kukkut Palan Yojna (HKPY)
summary: The scheme “Him Kukkut Palan Yojna” was launched by the Department of Animal Husbandry, Government of Himachal Pradesh to provide the subsidy to the entrepreneurs/farmers who are interested and engaged in poultry farming in the state.

title: Home Loan Interest Subsidy Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board (HLISS-GLWB)
summary: Under the scheme, a 3% Interest Subsidy is provided to workers who are employed in the organized sector to buy their own house and get relief from interest deductions on loans taken from banks.

title: Handicraft Mela Participation (HMP)
summary: The scheme enables artisans and handicraft organizations to participate in government-sponsored melas across Gujarat and other states, fostering market access and preserving traditional crafts. Benefits include subsidized stall fees, promotional support, sales opportunities for handmade products.

title: House of Himalayas (HHUK)
summary: The scheme aims to provide recognition and market reach to local Himalayan products of Uttarakhand through improved branding, packaging and sales. Under this scheme, local producers and self-help groups are supported to enhance their products’ quality, branding and market access.

title: Haryana Provision of Sports Equipment Scheme (HPOSEC)
summary: "Haryana Provision of Sports Equipment Scheme" by the Sports Dept, Government of Haryana provides sports equipment to Gram Panchayats and Municipal bodies to encourage youngsters in the state towards sports such as Volleyball, Football, Basketball, Handball, Boxing, Wrestling, Judo, Cricket, etc.

title: High Risk - High Reward Research (HR-HRR)
summary: The Scheme for Funding "High Risk - High Reward Research" aims at supporting proposals that are conceptually new & risky, & if successful, expected to have a paradigm-shifting influence on the S&T.

title: Handicraft Rebate Scheme (HRS-G)
summary: The scheme provides 5–20% rebates on sales of handicraft goods to cooperatives, with higher incentives for women-led groups and during festivals. Applications are submitted online via e-Kutir.

title: Handloom Rebate Scheme (HRS-G2)
summary: The scheme provides 10% special rebate for 120 festival days; Additional 5-15% permanent rebates for regular sales; Enhanced 20% rebates for women-led cooperatives. The scheme aims to enhance market competitiveness for Gujarat's handloom cooperatives and apex societies.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: \Small Cardamom Replanting/New Planting: Karnataka (Ha.) and other States (HSFEPQIISARADOCSCRNPKAOS)
summary: To motivate growers in Karnataka and other states to improve production and productivity through systematic replanting of diseased, old, and senile plantations, and to promote area expansion under cultivation.

title: Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata (HSS)
summary: “Hathkargha Samvardhan Sahayata” aims to meet the needs of handloom weavers for assistance on a larger scale for looms and accessories. It aims to provide financial assistance for technological up-gradation to improve the quality of the fabric and productivity.

title: Harvesting Tools Assistance for General Category (HRT-2) (HTAGC(HRT-2))
summary: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the General Category as well as to FPOs (Farmers Producer Organizations), FPCs (Farmers Producer Companies), FIGs (Farmer Interest Groups), SHGs (Self-Help Groups), and Cooperative Societies for purchasing harvesting tools.

title: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Castes (HRT-4) (HTASC(HRT4))
summary: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the SC category as well as to FPOs (Farmers Producer Organizations), FPCs (Farmers Producer Companies), FIGs (Farmer Interest Groups), SHGs (Self-Help Groups), and Cooperative Societies for purchasing harvesting tools.

title: Harvesting Tools Assistance for Scheduled Tribes (HRT-3) (HTAST(HRT3))
summary: Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided to farmers belonging to the ST category as well as to FPOs (Farmers Producer Organizations), FPCs (Farmers Producer Companies), FIGs (Farmer Interest Groups), SHGs (Self-Help Groups), and Cooperative Societies for purchasing harvesting tools.

title: Hands-on Training and Exposure Visits under Experiential Learning (HTEVEL)
summary: The scheme aims to provide free one-week residential hands-on certificate training programs to undergraduate, postgraduate students, researchers, and faculty members, including accommodation and meals.

title: India BPO Promotion Scheme (IBPS)
provider: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: The scheme aims to create employment opportunities and promote investment in the IT/ITeS sector by establishing BPO/ITeS units in smaller cities. Through this scheme, financial support in the form of Viability Gap Funding is provided to eligible companies.

title: Improved Cultivation and Advanced Retting Exercise (I-CARE) (ICARE)
summary: The scheme aims to support small and marginal jute growers with adequate pre and post harvesting operations to improve fiber quality and receive higher prices. The scheme provides 100% certified seeds at subsidized rates, free mechanical equipment, microbial consortiums, retting ponds.

title: International Cooperation Scheme- Capacity Building of First Time MSE Exporters (ICS-CBFTE)
provider: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: The scheme “International Cooperation Scheme” was launched by the MSME, Govt. of India with the aim to capacity build MSMEs for entering export market by providing reimbursement of various costs incurred by first time MSE exporters on export shipments.

title: International Cooperation Scheme: Market Development Assistance (ICS-MDA)
provider: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: The scheme “International Cooperation Scheme” was launched by the MSME, Govt. of India with the aim to capacity build MSMEs for entering the export market by facilitating their participation in international exhibitions/fairs/conferences/seminars/buyer-seller meets abroad.

title: Innovations for Defence Excellence (IDEX)
summary: Aimed at creation of an ecosystem to foster innovation and technology development in Defence and Aerospace by engaging Industries (incl MSMEs, start-ups, individual innovators R&D institutes, academia) and provide them grants and other supports to carry out R&D innovation for adoption in D&A Sector

title: "Infrastructure Development Subsidy (For IT/ITES)" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Capital Intensive Industries" (IDS-MESIFA-CII)
summary: Through this scheme, 30% Subsidy subject to a max. of ₹1,00,00,000/- will be granted on the investment made on building with a minimum extent of 50,000 sq.ft. constructed area, by the infrastructure developers/industries for leasing out to Information Technology industries or for own industrial use.

title: Incentives to Encourage Consumption of Local Raw Material Scheme, 2008 (IECLRMS)
summary: "Incentives to Encourage Consumption of Local Raw Material Scheme, 2008" promoted the use of local raw materials, supporting local manufacturers and village economies. It offered Sales Tax reimbursement and subsidies on power and water bills to eligible Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.

title: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm (NLMGIPBIEPG)
provider: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
summary: The scheme aims to enhance indigenous pig productivity through genetic upgradation. The scheme supports the establishment of pig semen collection and processing labs and the import of exotic pig germplasm.

title: Incentives To Encourage Purchases From Local Suppliers Scheme (IEPLSS-GOA)
summary: The scheme aims to encourage consumption through local purchases and support the economies of ancillary units, local Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, and traders. It provides a reimbursement of 2% (up to ₹5,00,000/- annually) on eligible local purchases to eligible manufacturing units in Goa.

title: Interest Free Loan (CBOCWWB) (IFL(CBOCWWB))
summary: Under this scheme, interest free loan shall be granted to the registered construction workers of the Board for the purchase of items like Fridge, Television/ LCD, Motor Cycle/Scooter, Cooler, Fan & Bicycle.

title: Interest Free Loan Scheme To Teachers For The Purchase Of Laptops (IFLSTPL)
summary: The scheme aims to enhance the quality of teaching in schools in the State of Goa by equipping teachers with necessary Information Technology knowledge and skills. It offers an Interest Free Loan up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- for purchasing a Laptop to regular/permanent, full-time teachers.

title: Incentives to Green Investment Scheme (IGIS)
summary: The scheme aims to incentivize investments by existing and new units in environmentally friendly initiatives. It provides financial support through reimbursement for Water and Energy Audits and Capital Reimbursement for Energy Conservation Equipment to eligible manufacturing units.

title: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- Post Doctoral Industrial Fellowship (IGSTCIF-PDIF)
summary: This programme is aimed at encouraging Postdoctoral researchers/fresh PhDs in S&T with appreciable track record and having aptitude for applied research and technology development.

title: IGSTC Industrial Fellowship- PhD Industrial Exposure Fellowship (IGSTCIFPHDIEF)
summary: The "Indo-German Science & Technology Centre (IGSTC) Industrial Fellowship Programme" was launched by Secretary, Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India on the occasion of IGSTC’s 11th Foundation Day on 14th June 2021 to support young Indian researchers for industrial exposure in German

title: Incredible India Bed & Breakfast Establishments (IIBBE)
summary: The scheme aims to provide standardized world-class Bed & Breakfast accommodation facilities, supplement tourist accommodation, and promote clean, affordable, and homely stays for domestic and foreign tourists in States and Union Territories where no State/UT approval scheme exists.

title: Incentives to Industries For Training Prospective Employees Scheme (IITPES)
summary: The scheme aims to address the skill gap in Goa by supporting industrial units to provide demand-driven Short Term Training Courses through recognized institutions, thereby creating manpower suitable for the industry. It offers reimbursement for 60% of training costs up to ₹60,000/- per trainee.

title: Issuing Legal Production Certificate (LPC) to Producers of Medicinal Plant Products for Export - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand (ILPCPMPPE)
summary: The scheme aims to facilitate the lawful export of endangered and CITES-listed medicinal plant species such as Kuth, Kutki, etc. by issuing Legal Production Certificates (LPC) to cultivators who legally grow these species on their own measured land.

title: Individual loaning scheme: Haryana Women Development Corporation (ILSHRWCD)
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to women for economically viable projects. Through this scheme, subsidies and loans are provided to eligible women for projects costing.

title: Innovation In Science Pursuit For Inspired Research (INSPIRE) - Faculty Fellowship (INSPIRE-FF)

title: Internet Subsidy Scheme (INTSS)
summary: Launched in 2018, the "Internet Subsidy Scheme" is one of the "IT Policy Schemes" by the Dept of IT, Govt of Goa. The objective is to provide Internet Subsidy to the eligible Information Technology Units in Goa. 25% reimbursement on high-speed bandwidth, subject to a maximum of ₹ 5,00,000 per annum.

title: Investment Promotion Assistance To Setup Large/Mega/Ultra-Mega Tourism Projects (IPASLMUMTP)

It offers financial assistance of up to 30% of the capital investment to investors who meet minimum investment thresholds and generate employment for Madhya Pradesh.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) For Handicraft Artisans: Assistance For Capital Investment For The Handloom And Handicrafts Artisans Of The U.T. Requiring Financial Assistance For Purchase Of Machinery Or Raw Materials (IPSHACIHH)
provider: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
summary: This is a sub-scheme under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)”, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, that aims to provide financial assistance for purchase of machinery or raw materials for development of their business.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Incentives For Doubling Of Export Values (IPSIDEV)
provider: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
summary: “Incentives For Doubling Of Export Values” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to extend support to MSMEs to increase exports and enhance export values.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Incentive For Local Employment (IPSILE)
provider: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
summary: “Incentive For Local Employment” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide One-time recruitment incentive to the Industrial Units for generating employment for local residents.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: III. Scheme C4: For Food Processing Industries (IPSTSFPI)
provider: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
summary: “Scheme For Food Processing Industries'' under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for Thrust Sectors, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide Interest Subsidy to the Establishment /Expansion of Food processing industries.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Thrust Sectors: Assistance For Furniture Sector (IPSTSAFFS)
provider: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
summary: “Assistance For Furniture Sector” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for Thrust Sectors, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to promote Furniture industries through providing various types of subsidy.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for Textile Sector: Assistance Of Interest Subsidy For Textile Sector (IPSTSAISTS)
provider: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
summary: “Assistance Of Interest Subsidy For Textile Sector” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for Textile Sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, aims to provide credit linked interest subsidy for Textile and Technical Textile sector.

title: Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS) for MSME Sector: Assistance For Zed Certification (IPSZED)
provider: Government of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
summary: “Assistance For Zed Certification” under the “Investment Promotion Scheme (IPS)” for MSME sector, implemented by the Dept. of Industries, U.T. Administration Of DNH & DD, was introduced to urge industries, especially (MSMEs), to manufacture goods in the country with “Zero Defects”.

title: "In-Plant Training" Component of the "Development of Industries" Scheme (IPT)
summary: "In-Plant Training" was introduced to create employment opportunities and motivate entrepreneurship among the educated unemployed youth. The trainees acquire the skill by observing, assisting and learning the job on their own in the plant itself, making them acquire better skills in the trade.

title: Industrial R&D Promotion Programme: Recognition Of In-House R&D Units (IRDPP-RIHRDU)
summary: DSIR is operating a scheme called "Recognition of In-House R&D Units" with the objective of granting recognition & registration to in-house R&D units established by the corporate industry. The In-house R&D units are expected to be engaged in innovative research & development activities.

title: Installation of Ropeway Infrastructure for Transport in Inaccessible Tourist Places or Forest Areas (IRITITPFA)
summary: The scheme aims to enhance connectivity in inaccessible tourist and forest areas by installing ropeways. It provides a Capital Investment Subsidy of 40% up to ₹5,00,00,000/- to private investors establishing ropeway infrastructure with a minimum investment of ₹1,00,00,000/-.

title: Incubation Scheme (IS)
provider: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: Incubation Scheme aims to promote and support untapped creativity and to promote adoption of latest technologies in MSMEs that seek the validation of their ideas at the proof-of-concept level.

title: "Interest Subsidy" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries" (IS-MESIFAI)
summary: The industrial units which have availed loans from financial institutions towards the creation of fixed assets and for working capital shall be eligible for an interest incentive to an extent of 25% of the annual interest amount paid. The applications are accepted offline.

title: "Interest Subsidy (For Micro, Small, Medium and Large New Industries)" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - Various Incentives" (IS-MESIFAI-VI)
summary: Through this scheme, the industrial units availing loans from financial institutions towards the creation of fixed assets and for working capital shall be eligible for an interest subsidy to an extent of 25% of the annual interest amount paid. The applications are accepted offline.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit) (ISEPQISRDC:EOP:LCCN)
summary: The scheme "Export Oriented Production: Large Cardamom Certified Nursery (Unit)" is a Sub-Scheme of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom by the Spice Board, Department of Commerce and Industry, Ministry of Commerce.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents: Basic quality testing of spices (ISFEPQIISARADOCNSBQTOS)
summary: To promote field-level basic quality testing of spices, enabling farmers to assess produce quality, negotiate better prices, and receive fair value for their produce.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Internal Control System (ICS) (nos) (ISFEPQIISARADOCOFICS)
summary: Under this scheme to support the grower groups / FPOs to establish grower group certification in order to prepare farmers on group formation, organic regulations, certification procedures, training, documentation, internal inspection etc. for organic certification and aggregation of the produce.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Organic Farming: Organic Certification Groups (ISFEPQIISARADOCOFOCG)
summary: Under this scheme to support farmer groups/FPOs in acquiring organic certification for the farm which is a prerequisite for marketing of organic spices.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: ICCD for Small Cardamom (nos) (Improved Cardamom Curing Devices) (ISFEPQIISARADOCPHICDSCNOSICCD)
summary: The scheme aims to encourage cardamom growers to adopt Improved Cardamom Curing Devices (ICCD) for drying small cardamom, thereby improving the quality of the produce and making it more suitable for export.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Pepper thresher (nos) (ISFEPQIISARADOCPHIPTNOS)
summary: To motivate the pepper growers to produce good quality pepper for export by promoting installation of pepper threshers for hygienic separation of pepper berries from the spikes.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Seed spice thresher (nos) (ISFEPQIISARADOCPHISST)
summary: To motivate the farmers to adopt hygienic threshing practices for production of quality seed spices using mechanical seed spices threshers (power operated)

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Post-Harvest Improvement: Turmeric boiler ( nos) (ISFEPQIISARADOCPHITBNOS)
summary: To motivate the growers to boil the turmeric hygienically using steam boiling unit and to produce quality turmeric suitable for exports

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Small Cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Rain water harvesting structure (nos) (ISFEPQIISARADOCSCILDRWHS)
summary: Under this scheme to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation and land development by constructing rain water harvesting structures for increasing the productivity and improving quality of small cardamom.

title: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents:FRESH-IT (Farmer’s Research & Enterprise in Spice Holdings for Innovative Technology) (ISFEPQISARADOCNSFFREISHFIT)
summary: To encourage spice farmers to adopt innovative technologies and develop improved spice varieties and cost-effective post-harvest machinery to enhance the production, productivity, and quality of spices.

title: Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers (ISFSR)
summary: The "Incentive Scheme for Sericulture Reelers" is aimed at improving the financial condition of minority communities involved in silk reeling and spinning. The corporation will provide loans to support working capital and basic infrastructure for silk spinners.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (ISMPSISTL)
summary: “Interest Subsidy on Term Loan” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide subsidy on annual interest liability on the Term Loan borrowed from a Bank to an approved project.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: State Capital Investment Subsidy (ISMPSSCIS)
summary: “State Capital Investment Subsidy” incentives under “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide subsidy of the fixed capital investment made for its approved project.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Energy Efficiency (ISMPSSEE)
summary: “Subsidy for Energy Efficiency” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement for the cost of energy audit and installations for energy conservation as per energy audit.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Patent Registration (ISMPSSPR)
summary: “Subsidy for Patent Registration” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred by it for obtaining Patent Registration.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fees (ISMPSSSD)
summary: “Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fees” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement for stamp duty and registration fee paid by it for the purpose of registration of documents.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST) (ISMPSSSGST)
summary: “Subsidy for State Goods and Services Tax (SGST)” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide refund of Net SGST paid to the Government of West Bengal for its approved project.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance (ISMPSSSQC)
summary: “Subsidy for Standard Quality Compliance” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of the expenditure incurred for obtaining certification from approved Institutions/ Research Labs.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Subsidy for Water Conservation/ Environment Compliance (ISMPSSWCEC)
summary: “Subsidy for Water Conservation/ Environment Compliance” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement for expenditure incurred towards cost of captive sound pollution control devices.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Waiver of Electricity Duty (ISMPSWED)
summary: “Waiver of Electricity Duty” incentives under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of electricity duty on the electricity consumed for the manufacturing activity.

title: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Work Force Welfare Assistance (ISMPSWFWA)
summary: “Work Force Welfare Assistance” incentive under the “Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME & T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred for paying contribution towards ESI and EPF.

title: Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme (ISRS)
summary: Through the "Interest Subsidy Reimbursement Scheme”, the projects which show immense promise and potential will be eligible for a grant of 30% of the loan interest amount, for the purpose of repayment of the interest component of a loan availed.

title: Interest Subvention Scheme (ISS)
summary: The scheme aims to provide institutional credit for capital investments at reasonable interest rates and is implemented through the Karnataka State Financial Corporation (KSFC) in the state.

title: Interest Subsidy Scheme for Smaller Business Units (ISSFSU)
summary: Launched in 2018, the "Internet Subsidy Scheme" is one of the "Information Technology Policy Schemes" by the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa. The objective and the scope of this scheme is to provide Internet Subsidy to the eligible Information Technology Units in Goa.

title: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2008 (ISS2008)
summary: "Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2008" boosted economic growth by providing interest subsidies to Micro and Small Enterprises. The scheme offered financial incentives to new enterprises, making their operations more viable and promoting industrial growth.

title: Interest Subsidy Scheme, 2017 (ISS2017)
summary: The scheme aims to incentivize units for making their enterprises financially viable. It provides interest subsidy on term loan and/or working capital loan (up to ₹25,00,000/- per year, or ₹27,50,000/- for women/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe applicants) to eligible industries.

title: Industrial Sector Scheme (HSFDC) (ISSHSFDC)
summary: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from BPL families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural & urban areas for various self-employment income-generating activities such as carpentry, leather and leather goods manufacturing, etc.

title: Interest Subsidy Scheme for Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe Entrepreneurs (ISSSCSTE)
summary: The scheme aims to encourage SC/ST entrepreneurs to establish micro or small-scale service enterprises & to expand, diversify, or modernize their existing units. Under this scheme, a loan amount ranging from a min. of ₹20.00 lakhs to a max. of ₹1,000.00 lakhs is provided at an interest rate of 4%.

title: "Interest Subvention on Working Capital" under the "Assam Tea Industries Special Incentives Scheme" (ISWC-ATISIS)
summary: The scheme aims to ensure long term financial sustainability of the Tea industry and incentivize Orthodox tea production over Crush, Tear, Curl tea. It provides interest subvention, production subsidies, plant & machinery subsidies, tax holidays to tea plantations and manufacturing units in Assam.

title: IT Incubation Centre - Information Technology Development Agency (ITICITDA)
summary: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship and innovation in the fields of Information Technology, Medical Technology, Electronics, Artificial Intelligence, Biotechnology, and related sectors by providing a supportive ecosystem for startups.

title: IT Policy and Amendments-2020 - Information Technology Development Agency (ITPAITDA)
summary: The policy aims to promote the growth of IT, ITES, Internet Service Provider, and Telecom Service Provider industries in Uttarakhand by supporting startups, and creating employment opportunities for local youth through policy incentives and initiatives.

title: "Innovation in Technology [Product (or) Process]" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises” (ITPP-MESIFAI-SA-MSME)
summary: The award "Innovation in Technology [Product (or) Process]" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises” is conferred upon the industrial units who have patented their technology innovation.

title: IT Saksham Yuva Scheme (ITSYS)
summary: The Haryana Government is to provide employment opportunities to youths (graduate/post-graduate applicants) from engineering and IT backgrounds who shall undertake the Haryana IT Program (specially designed short-term courses) for the duration of a minimum of 3 months offered.

title: Incentives to Women Entrepreneurs Scheme, 2008 (IWES)
summary: "Incentives to Women Entrepreneurs Scheme, 2008" aimed to encourage women entrepreneurship and promote self-employment by providing additional incentives such as interest subsidies and preferential treatment under capital contribution schemes. The scheme benefited women-owned industrial units.

title: Jhota Buggi/Camel/Mule Cart Scheme (HSFDC) (JBCMCSHSFDC)
summary: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans to individuals from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural and urban areas for purchasing animal-driven carts such as Jhota Buggis, camel carts, and mule carts.

title: J.C. Bose Fellowship (JCBS)
summary: The “J.C. Bose fellowship” is awarded to active scientists in recognition of their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective.

title: Jute Design Resource Centre Scheme (JDRCS)
summary: The scheme aims to foster innovation and product diversification in the Jute Diversified Products sector. It provides innovative designs, skill training, and technical specifications to Jute Artisans, Micro Small and Medium Enterprises, Exporters, and Women Self Help Groups.

title: Jute Diversification Scheme (JDS)
summary: The scheme aims to set up production centres to promote eco-friendly jute products and generate sustained employment. It provides skill training, machine subsidies, and financial incentives to collaborating agencies, targeting artisans, women self-help groups, and entrepreneurs.

title: Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana (JGVY)
summary: The scheme provides margin money subsidies (25–30%) for new rural industrial projects (₹1,00,000/- to 25,00,000/-) to artisans, entrepreneurs, and SHGs, leveraging a 24-hour electricity supply in villages. Beneficiaries must be aged 25–50 years with a Class 10th education.

title: Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana (JMGGY)
summary: The scheme "Jharkhand Mukhyamantri Gram Gadi Yojana" by the Transport Department, Government of Jharkhand, aims to enhance rural connectivity and provide affordable transportation facilities to rural residents. It supports private bus operators to operate on rural routes with financial assistance...

title: Junior Research Fellowship In Sciences, Humanities, And Social Sciences (JRFSHSS)
summary: The scheme of Junior Research Fellowship in Sciences, Humanities, and Social Science by UGC, Dept. of Education, is open to candidates who qualify for the National Eligibility Test-Junior Research Fellowship(NET-JRF) of the UGC and the UGC-Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (UGC-CSIR).

title: Junior Research Fellowship In Engineering & Technology (JRFST)
summary: The scheme "Junior Research Fellowship in Engineering & Technology" by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education is meant for candidates who wish to pursue research leading to a Ph.D. degree in engineering and technology.

title: Jeevanam Self-Employment Scheme To Dependents Of Crime Victims (JS-ESDCV)
summary: The scheme “Jeevanam Self-Employment Scheme to Dependents of Crime Victims” was launched by the Department of Social Justice, Government of Kerala.

title: Kisan Credit Card (Pashupalan) (KCCP)
summary: The scheme aims to provide short-term working capital loans for livestock activities by offering eligible livestock farmers interest-subsidized loans for operational purposes through banks.

title: Kisan Credit Card Scheme for Fisheries- Chief Minister Fishermen Prosperity Scheme (KCCSF-CMFPS)
summary: The scheme aims to provide short-term loans for fisheries. It offers zero-percent interest working capital to the fish farmers through cooperative banks.

title: Konkani Drama Competition (KDC)
summary: The "Konkani Drama Competition" is a cultural scheme by Kala Academy under the Dept. of Art and Culture, Govt. of Goa. It is held annually to promote theatre among the institutions. Eligible participants are those registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, with renewed registration.

title: Janshree Bima Yojana for Khadi Artisans (KKJBY)
provider: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: The scheme aims to provide insurance cover to Khadi artisans. Through this scheme, group insurance benefits are provided to Khadi artisans (spinners and weavers).

title: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Incentive for Self Employment (KKN-IFSE)
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance not exceeding ₹50,000/- or the actual cost, whichever is less, to needy Goan artists or their families for setting up self-employment ventures, helping them establish sustainable income sources. The applications for this scheme are accepted Offline.

title: KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme (KSCSTE-ESS )
summary: The scheme “KSCSTE Emeritus Scientist Scheme” helps to provide opportunity to superannuated outstanding scientists to pursue research in their respective field of specialization and to harness their knowledge and erudition for the development of State.

title: Karkhandar Scheme For Development Of Craft Sector (KSDCS)
summary: A training and skilling upgradation scheme by the Dept. of Industries & Commerce and implemented by the Directorate of Handicraft & Handloom, Govt. of Jammu & Kashmir wherein passout meritorious trainees and ex-trainees from departmental training centers are are provided skill upgradation training.

title: Kerala Stressed MSMEs Revival & Rehabilitation Scheme (KSMSMERRS)
summary: The “Kerala Stressed MSMEs Revival & Rehabilitation Scheme” intends to provide financial and other handholding support to the MSMEs which show signs of stress and to convert their non-productive assets into productive assets.

title: Karma Sathi Prakalpa (KSP)
summary: The scheme aims to help young entrepreneurs in the state establish new manufacturing enterprises and small businesses, including those offering services and trading. The scheme offers soft loans and subsidies for new income-generating projects.

title: Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme Karnataka (KSSK)
summary: The "Kayaka Spoorthi Scheme" aims to provide financial assistance to women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) engaged in the leather industry. The goal is to promote self-sufficiency and economic independence by enabling these women to start or expand business activities related to leatherwork.

title: Kerala State Young Scientist Awards (KSYSA)
summary: The “Kerala State Young Scientist Awards” by the KSCSTE are intended to honour talented young Scientists in recognition of their outstanding contributions in any branch of science and technology coming within the purview of the Council.

title: Karma Veer Dadasaheb Gaikwad Sabalikaran & Swabhiman Yojana (KVDGSSY)
summary: The main objective of this scheme is to improve the financial condition of the scheduled castes and Nav-Buddhists who are landless workers and are from "Below Poverty Line". Only citizens who are permanent residents of Maharashtra are eligible. This scheme is 100% funded by the State Govt.

title: Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme (KVPS)
summary: ‘Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme’ was relaunched in the year 2014 by the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry Of Finance, Government of India in view of the popular demand and to revitalize Small Savings. The amount invested in Kisan Vikas Patra (KYP) doubles in 115 months at the present rate.

title: Kishore Vaigyanik Protsahan Yojana (KVPY)
summary: The KVPY is a national fellowship program in basic sciences, initiated and funded by the Department of Science and Technology to attract exceptionally motivated students to pursue basic science courses and a research career in science.

title: Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana - Karnataka (KVY-K)
summary: The “Kaimagga Vikasa Yojana” aims to sustain and develop the handloom weaving skills of existing weavers and to attract young talent to the industry, thus preserving the rich cultural heritage of handloom weaving in Karnataka.

title: Khadi Gramodyog Vikas Yojana: Khadi Vikas Yojana (KGVYKVY)
provider: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
summary: The scheme aims to increase productivity and wages of Khadi artisans, improve production infrastructure, boost employment and sales, revive traditional rural skills, modernize sales outlets, and promote marketing and exports.

title: LIDCOM 50% Subsidy Scheme (L50SS)
summary: The "50% Subsidy Scheme" is a scheme by LIDCOM, Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, 50% amount is being given as a subsidy on a maximum loan amount of ₹50,000/-. The subsidy is subject to the maximum limit of ₹10,000/-. The bank charge of interest is as per the existing rate.

title: Loan Assistance to Scheduled Castes Students for Commercial Pilot Training (LASCSCPT)
summary: The scheme was commenced in the year 1987 with the objective to provide financial assistance to bright Scheduled Castes Students who want to undergo training for commercial pilot license.

title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Education Loan (LBSSF-EL)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The scheme aims to provide education loans to the students from the community of safai karamcharis\manual scavengers & their dependents for pursuing higher education.

title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - General Term Loan (GTL) (LBSSF-GTL)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: A general term loan scheme by the Ministry of Social justice and Empowerment for Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavengers, and their dependants aged 18 years and above.

title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Sanitary Marts Scheme (LBSSK-SMS)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: A sanitary mart is a one-stop-shop for all things for sanitation and hygiene. It is a shopping place where the sanitary needs of the common man could be met. It serves both as a shop and as a service centre.

title: Loan based Scheme for Pay and Use Community Toilets (LBSFPAUCT)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The “Pay and Use” Community Toilets Scheme under Swachhta Udyami Yojana by NSKFDC offers concessional loans to Safai Karamcharis and their dependents for setting up public toilet units, promoting sanitation, livelihood, and dignity.

title: Loan Based Schemes For Safai Karamchari - Swachhta Udyami Yojana – Swachhta Se Sampannta Ki Aur (LBSSK-SUY)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The scheme aims to ensure mechanised cleaning and provide related safe and sustainable livelihood opportunities to Safai Karamcharis and liberated Manual Scavengers. The Financial assistance is provided for the procurement and operation of sanitation-related equipment and vehicles for the target.

title: Land/Built-Up Area Rebate Scheme (LBUARS)
summary: "Land/Built-Up Area Rebate Scheme" by the Dept. of IT, Govt. of Goa. The scheme aims to provide Land / Built-up Area Rebate to the IT Industry in the state of Goa. A one-time rebate for the purchase of Land for creating IT Office Space and for the purchase of Built-Up office space for IT operations.

title: Lakhpati Didi Yojana - Uttarakhand (LDYUK)
summary: The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the economic status of women in Uttarakhand by empowering them to become financially self-reliant and achieve the status of “Lakhpati Didis.”

title: Logistics Excellence, Advancement, and Performance Shield (LEAAPS)
summary: The scheme aims to acknowledge and celebrate best practices and innovations in the logistics industry across sectors. It also aims to promote sustainability, efficiency, and technological advancement in alignment with national logistics initiatives.

title: LIDCOM Education Loan Scheme (LELS)
summary: The "Education Loan Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Govt. of Maharashtra. In this scheme, finance of upto ₹ 20,00,000 is provided for post graduate students in the 18-50 years age group from Charmakar Community for studies in India and in abroad.

title: License for Repairers of Weights-Measures and Weighing Instruments (LRWMWI)
summary: Under this scheme, a government-approved license is issued to repairers of weights and measuring instruments, enabling them to repair such instruments used by traders as a means of self-employment and to ensure their livelihood.

title: Loan For Foreign Study (E.B.C.) (LFS-EBC)
summary: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Educationally Backward Class (EBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to EBC students.

title: Loan For Foreign Study (S.E.B.C.) (LFS-SEBC)
summary: The scheme aims to support higher education abroad for eligible students from the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC). It provides a maximum Foreign Study Loan of ₹15,00,000/- at an annual interest rate of 4% to SEBC students.

title: LIDCOM Gattai Stall Scheme (LGSS)
summary: Being implemented by LIDCOM, Govt. of Maharashtra for the Roadsides Cobblers from the (Scheduled Caste) Charmakar Community, this scheme provides a 100% subsidy for the erection of a Tin Stall of Size 4’ x 5’ x 6.5’ costing ₹16367/- per stall and ₹500/- incidental charges.

title: LIDCOM Margin Money Loan Scheme (LMMLS)
summary: In this scheme, for a loan limit from ₹50,001 to ₹5,00,000/-, 20% of the Project cost loan as Seed Capital is paid by the Corporation @ 4% interest per annum. A maximum of ₹10,000/- will be paid as a subsidy by Corporation. A 5% amount of project cost will have to be contributed by the beneficiary.

title: Livestock Mission Scheme - Interest Payment on Loan (LMSIPL)
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-employment opportunities at the local level by encouraging livestock-based entrepreneurship and reducing the financial burden on beneficiaries through payment of 90% of the bank loan interest by the State Government.

title: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled) (LOPSD)
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among persons with disabilities through grants, term loans, and margin money assistance.

title: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Caste) (LOPSSC)
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Castes. It provides financial aid, including loans, margin money, and grants, for livelihood projects.

title: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribes) (LOPSST)
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Tribe individuals through financial support, including loans, margin money, and grants.

title: Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB) (LPT-GBOCWWB)
summary: "Loan for the Purchase of Tools (GBOCWWB)" is a Welfare Scheme by the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the Dept of Labour and Employment, Govt of Goa. Through this scheme, the worker registered with the Board is provided with a loan of ₹5,000/- for the purchase of tools.

title: Loan for the Purchase of Work Tool for the Construction Workers (LPWTCW)
summary: "Loan for the Purchase of Work Tool for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Dept., Delhi, is a welfare scheme that provides an amount not exceeding ₹20,000/- as loan to the members of the fund, for the purchase of work related tools.

title: Lease Rental Rebate Scheme for Goan Diaspora (LRSGD)
summary: The "Lease Rental Rebate Scheme for Goan Diaspora" is one of the "IT Policy Schemes" by the Dept of IT, Govt of Goa. The objective is to provide Lease Rental Rebate for Goan Diaspora. A 100% reimbursement of the lease rentals will be provided for a period of first 6 months of operations.

title: Lease Rental Subsidy Scheme (LRSS)
summary: Launched in 2018, the "Lease Rental Subsidy Scheme" is one of the "Information Technology Policy Schemes" by the Department of Information Technology, Government of Goa. The objective and the scope of this scheme is to provide Lease Rental Subsidy to the eligible Information Technology Units in Goa.

title: Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society For Interest Free Loan (LSMPCIFL)
summary: The scheme provides interest-free loans to citizens through a cooperative society. The maximum loan amount offered is ₹45,000/-, with zero interest charged.

title: Large Sized Multi Purpose Coop. Society: Jewel Loan (Interest Free) (LSMPCJL)
summary: The scheme offers citizens interest-free loans up to ₹1,00,000/- on jewels, helping them meet various financial needs without the burden of interest rates.

title: Large Sized Multi-Purpose Coop. Society: Medium Term Loan to Tribal Members (LSMPCLTT)
summary: The scheme offers medium-term loans of up to ₹60,000/- without interest to tribal members, enabling them to fulfill various financial needs.

title: Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC) (LTCPG)
summary: The scheme "Loan for Training of Commercial Pilot (GUEEDC)" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial loan assistance of up to ₹25,00,000/- at 4% simple interest per annum is provided to Unreserved category candidates for pursuing commercial pilot training.

title: Long Term-Loan to SC Co-op Spinning Mills under Special Component Plan (LTLTSCOSMUSCP)
summary: The scheme "Long Term-Loan to SC Co-op Spinning Mills under Special Component Plan" was introduced by the Department of Social Justice & Special Assistance, Government of Maharashtra. The scheme aims to promote the development of spinning mills owned by scheduled caste members.

title: Loans for Tools (MBOCWWB) (LT(MBOCWWB))
summary: Under the scheme, a one-time grant will be granted to all members of the fund for the purchase of tools subject to the conditions.

title: Low Tension Power Tariff (LTPT) Subsidy (LTPTS)
summary: The scheme "Low Tension Power Tariff (LTPT) Subsidy" is introduced to assist MSME enterprises in reducing their electricity costs. A subsidy of 20% is given for 36 months from the date of commencement of production or from the date of obtaining power connection, whichever is later.

title: LIDCOM Training Scheme (LTS)
summary: Being implemented particularly for the Charmakar Community, the "Training Scheme" is a scheme by the Leather Industries Development Corporation (LIDCOM), Govt. of Maharashtra. This scheme is being implemented for the students to enable them to start their own businesses, trade, or get a job.

title: Loans to Tribal Students for Higher Studies Abroad (LTSHSA)
summary: The scheme's purpose is to offer financial assistance to tribal students for higher education abroad. It provides a loan of up to ₹15,00,000 at a 4% annual interest rate.

title: Laghu Vyavassay Scheme (LVSH)
summary: "Laghu Vyavassay Scheme" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Govt of Haryana. In this scheme, loans are provided to individuals from Scheduled Castes for self-employment/ income-generating activities.

title: Lab on Wheels (LW)
summary: This program has been launched to promote & popularize science education among school students and youth studying science subjects across all 13 districts of Uttarakhand.

title: Meghalaya Any Business Venture Scheme (MABVS)
summary: The Meghalaya Any Business Ventures Scheme, part of the Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program, provides financial support to 50 entrepreneurs across the state to start their own businesses.

title: Madilu Kit
summary: The Madilu Programme is a government initiative focused on empowering rural communities through skill development and entrepreneurship opportunities. It aims to create sustainable livelihoods, reduce poverty, and enhance social and economic well-being in rural areas.

title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jati / Anusuchit Janjati Udyami Yojana (MAJAJUY)
summary: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance for setting up businesses.

title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana (MAJVPVPY)
summary: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana" under the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department, Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance for special project proposals received in the interest of the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.

title: Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana (MAKY)
summary: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana” was launched by the Department of Industrial Policy and Investment Promotion, Government of Madhya Pradesh on 1st August 2014.

title: Mukhyamantri Ati Pichhada Varg Udyami Yojana (MAPVUY)
summary: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

title: Mukhyamantri Alpsankhyak Rozgar Rinn Yojana (MARRY)
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide loans of up to ₹5,00,000/- at a simple annual interest rate of 5% to youths from minority communities (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Buddhist, Jain, and Parsi) for generating employment.

title: Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme (MARVS)
summary: The scheme “Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to provide Small Commercial Vehicles and pickups at each CD Block across Meghalaya with 50% financial aid from the Government of Meghalaya.

title: Marketing Assistance Scheme (MAS)
summary: The "Marketing Assistance Scheme" aims to empower SC leather artisans by enabling them to market their products through Lidkar Leather Emporia under the Lidkar brand. It helps artisans avoid exploitation by private dealers and provides regular procurement of their products based on demand.

title: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Udyami Yojana (MAUYB)
summary: This is a flagship scheme of the Bihar government aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among the youth by providing financial assistance of up to ₹10,00,000/- for setting up businesses.

title: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana (MAYNSKFDC-H)
summary: Under this scheme, loan is provided to woman Safai Karamchari and their dependent daughters for projects with a maximum project cost of up to ₹2,00,000/- for small and petty trade/businesses, and various income-generating activities such as beauty parlors, boutiques, cosmetic shop, bangle shop, etc.

title: Mizoram Bana Kaih (Handholding) Scheme (MBKHHS)
summary: The scheme aims to empower individuals and organizations by providing financial, technical, and institutional support for livelihood, entrepreneurship, and employment generation. It also promotes sustainable socio-economic development and youth engagement in Mizoram.

title: Mahila Bakri Palan (MBP)
summary: The scheme aims to empower women, especially abandoned, widowed, destitute, single, and disaster-affected women, by providing them support for goat rearing to generate livelihood and improve household income.

title: Micro Credit Finance (MCF)
summary: Under the Micro Credit Finance Scheme, beneficiaries from the Charmkar Community receive financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 at an interest rate of 5% per annum. This assistance includes a subsidy of ₹10,000, with the remaining amount provided as a loan.

title: Micro Credit Finance (NSFDC) (MCFNSFDC)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The scheme is implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. Under this scheme, loans are provided to individuals from the SC community for units costing up to ₹1,40,000/- for income-generating activities.

title: Micro Credit Finance under NSKFDC- Haryana (MCFNSKFDC-H)
summary: Under this scheme, loan is provided to Safai Karamchari and their dependents for projects with a maximum cost up to ₹1,00,000/- per beneficiaries for small and petty trade/business and various income generating activities.

title: Meghalaya Cinema Theatre Scheme (MCTS)
summary: The scheme's objective is to promote youth entrepreneurship and employment in Meghalaya by supporting cinema theatres while preserving the state’s cultural heritage.

title: Motorcycle Taxi Yojana (MCTY)
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing interest-free loans for purchasing motorcycles or scooters to operate as motorcycle taxis, thereby enhancing tourism connectivity and generating livelihood opportunities in the state.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana (PMMSYMCIBHR)
summary: The scheme aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport.

title: Market Development Assistance (MDA-FERT)
summary: The scheme aims to promote organic fertilizers produced at Bio-Gas and Compressed Bio-Gas plants under the Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan initiative. It provides Market Development Assistance of ₹1,500/- per Metric Tonne to manufacturing and marketing entities of organic fertilizers.

title: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat (MDAMEAO)
summary: The scheme "Assistance to Organizers for Organizing Industrial Exhibitions in Gujarat" under the "Market Development Assistance to MSMEs" aims to provide financial assistance to organizers of industrial exhibitions in Gujarat.

title: Market Development Assistance to MSMEs: Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International) (MDAMENI)
summary: The scheme "Assistance to MSME Manufacturing Sector Participation in the Exhibition (National and International)" under the "Market Development Assistance to MSMEs" aims to offer reimbursement for stall rent, product literature, and display materials to MSMEs participating in exhibitions.

title: Marketing Development Assistance Scheme (MDAS)
summary: The Marketing Development Assistance (MDA) Scheme under the Overseas Promotion & Publicity (OPP) Scheme aims to support the promotion and marketing of Indian tourism in overseas markets.

title: Mahila Dairy Vikas Pariyojana - Uttarakhand (MDVPUK)
summary: The scheme aims to empower rural women in Uttarakhand by promoting their active participation in the dairy sector through Women Milk Producers Cooperative Societies, enhancing milk production, and providing training, incentives, and awareness programs for sustainable livelihood development.

title: Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme (MDDS)
summary: The Chief Minister’s CM-ELEVATE Program includes Meghalaya Dairy Development Scheme under the Planning Dept, Govt of Meghalaya. The scheme aims to employ, engage, and empower the youth and rural communities by promoting Dairy related entrepreneurship through easy access to credit and subsidies.

title: "Market Development Support Assistance" under "Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - Various Incentives" (MDSA-MESIFAI-VI)
summary: Through "Market Development Support Assistance", assistance worth 50% of total rent, literature and display material (subject to a max. of ₹5,00,000/-) is provided to the industrial unit for participation in international trade fair as an industry association. The applications are accepted offline.

title: Motivation of Entrepreneurs and Financial Assistance for Rehabilitation of Sick Industries (MEFARSI)
summary: Through this scheme, the cost of implementing suggestions given by the experts in the field of technology, marketing and finance engaged to advise sick units is reimbursed. 50% subsidy towards the cost of diagnostic study by technical institutions initiated through Financial Institutions/Banks/etc.

title: Migrants Employment Generation Programme (Megp)
