title: Uttar Poorva Transformative Industrialization Scheme (UNNATIDPIIT)
summary: The UNNATI (Uttar Poorva Transformative Industrialization Scheme), 2024, is a Government of India initiative for Northeastern region of India offering various incentives to the industries in both sectors Manufacturing and Service.

title: Udyogini Scheme (US)
summary: Udyogini is an innovative scheme to assist women in gaining self-reliance and economic independence through self-employment, mainly through trade and the service sector. It also provides for a subsidy on loans for undertaking business activities/ micro enterprises through banks, etc.

title: Uttarakhand State Science & Technology Congress (USSTC)
summary: The Science & Technology Congress aims to foster scientific talent and encourage emerging scientists and researchers in the state. The congress is organized annually by UCOST and attracts significant participation from young researchers and scientists.

title: Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (Uyegp)
summary: The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Department, Government of Tamil Nadu introduced the scheme "Unemployed Youth Employment Generation Programme (UYEGP)" which aims to mitigate the unemployment problems of socially and economically weaker sections of the society.

title: VAIshwik BHArtiya Vaigyanik (VAIBHAV) Fellowship
summary: VAIBHAV Fellowship envisages collaboration between scientists of Indian Diaspora with Indian Higher Educational Institutions/Universities/Public Funded Scientific Institutions. Fellow would identify an Indian Institution for collaboration & may spend upto two months in a year for a max. of 3 years.

title: Visiting Advanced Joint Research Faculty Scheme (VAJRA)
summary: VAJRA Faculty Scheme is a dedicated program exclusively for overseas scientists and academicians with emphasis on NRI and Persons of Indian Origin/Overseas Citizen of India to work as adjunct/visiting faculty for a specific period of time in Indian Public funded academic and research institutions.

title: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Caste individuals by providing concessional finance. Benefits include investment ranging from ₹10,00,000/- to ₹15,00,00,000/- as debt or equity for eligible Private Limited or Public Limited companies.

title: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Paryatan Swarojgar Yojana (VCSGPSY)
summary: The scheme aims to promote tourism-based self-employment and entrepreneurship among unemployed residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for the development of tourism-related infrastructure and services. This scheme is applicable in entire Uttarakhand.

title: Vocational Education and Training Loan Scheme (VETLS)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The Vocational Education and Training Loan Scheme provides financial assistance to youth of the target group to enhance their skills & employability.

title: Vanchit Ikai Samooh aur Vargon ki Aarthik Sahayata Yojana (VISVAS) for Individual (VISVASI)
provider: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
summary: The VISVAS Scheme provides interest subvention on income-generating loans to SC, OBC, and Safai Karamchari individuals through Public Sector Banks, Regional Rural Banks, Private Sector Banks, Small Finance Banks, and other participating lending institutions.

title: Vishesh Katan, Vankari & Vanat Sahay (Spinning & Weaving Assistance Scheme) (VKVVS-SWAS)
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in addition to the central government assistance to spinners and weavers. It provides production incentives to Khadi spinners and weavers with category-wise differential assistance rates.

title: Virasat Loan Scheme of NMDFC (VLS-NMDFC)
summary: Concessional credit of up to ₹10,00,000/- can be availed under Credit Line-1 & 2. to meet Working Capital and Fixed Capital for purchase of equipment/tools/machineries/raw material by the Minority Artisan.

title: Self-Employment Scheme: Vahan Loan Sahay Yojana (SESVLSY)
summary: "Vahan Loan Sahay Yojana" is a component under the "Self-Employment Scheme" that provides on-road unit cost to self-employed individuals for purchasing vehicles such as rickshaws, loading rickshaws, Maruti cars, and jeep taxis.

title: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Full Time PhD Candidates (VPHD_FT)
provider: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: The scheme aims at generating a total of 1000 Full-time PhD Candidates in emerging research areas of Electronic System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (ITES) sectors over a period of 5 years.

title: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Post-Doctoral Fellowships (PDF) (VPHD_PDF)
provider: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: This fellowship is meant for those who have a proven track record as evident from their research publications & recognitions. Support is provided for 225 Post-Doctoral Fellowships for candidates for a period of 1 year, to encourage specialized research in emerging area.

title: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Part Time PhD Candidates (VPHD_PT)
provider: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: The scheme aims at generating a total of 150 Part-time PhDs in emerging research areas of Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) and IT/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES) sectors over a period of 5 years.

title: Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme (VPLS)
summary: The "Vrutti Protsaha Loan Scheme" is an initiative by the Karnataka Minority Development Corporation (KMDC) to promote self-employment and economic activities among minority communities. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible individuals from minority communities.

title: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme: Facilitation Supports (WBAFBSFS)
summary: “Facilitation Supports” is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, implemented by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal. It aims to provide various types of facilitation support to the artisans and Industrial Cooperative Societies.

title: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society (WBAFBSGICS)
summary: “Grant to Industrial Cooperative Society” is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme 2024”, by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal. It aims to create, support and sustain an enabling ecosystem for strengthening creativity and capacity of the artisans.

title: West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme: Support for Digital Marketing (WBAFBSSDM)
summary: “Support for Digital Marketing” is a sub-scheme under "West Bengal Artisans Financial Benefit Scheme”, by the MSME and Textiles Dept, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide access to digital markets and e-commerce to the artisans.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Additional Incentive on Generation of Employment (WBISAIGE)
summary: “Additional Incentive on Generation of Employment” incentives under “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme” scheme by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred for paying contribution towards ESI and EPF.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Additional Incentive for Adventure Tour Operators (WBISAITO)
summary: “Additional Incentive for Adventure Tour Operators” incentives under the “WBIS” scheme by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement incentives with SGST payments for purchasing tents, dinghies, adventure & sports equipment, and related accessories.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Capacity Utilisation (WBISCU)
summary: “Capacity Utilisation” incentives under the “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme” implemented by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide additional Floor Area Ratio (FAR) over and above the maximum permissible FAR as may be fixed by the competent authority.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Interest Subsidy on Term Loan (WBISISTL)
summary: “Interest Subsidy on Term Loan” incentives under “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme” scheme by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide Interest Subsidy on annual interest liability on the Term Loan borrowed from a Bank to an approved project of an eligible unit.

title: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Power Subsidy (WBTISPS)
summary: “Power Subsidy” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME&T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide power subsidy on electricity consumption for 5 years from the date of commencement of production.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (WBISRSDRF)
summary: “Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fee” incentives under the “WBIS” scheme implemented by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fee paid by the eligible units for the purpose of registration of documents.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: State Capital Investment Subsidy (WBISSCIS)
summary: “State Capital Investment Subsidy” incentives under “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a State Capital Investment Subsidy of the fixed capital investment.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Subsidy for Quality Improvement (WBISSQI)
summary: “Subsidy for Quality Improvement” incentives under the “WBIS” scheme aims to provide a reimbursement for the fixed capital investment expenditure incurred for quality improvement, modernization and installation of pollution control devices and for obtaining ISI/BIS/ISO certification.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Tourism Promotion Assistance in lieu of Interest Subsidy (WBISTPAIS)
summary: “Tourism Promotion Assistance in lieu of Interest Subsidy” incentive under the “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme” aims to provide Tourism Promotion Assistance for SGST irrespective of the location of the project, which will be in lieu of interest subsidy.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Waiver of Electricity Duty (WBISWED)
summary: “Waiver of Electricity Duty” incentives under “The West Bengal Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of Tourism, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide waiver of electricity duty on the electricity consumed in its approved project.

title: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Incentive for Energy Efficiency (WBTISIEE)
summary: “Incentive for Energy Efficiency” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME&T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement for the cost of energy and installations for energy conservation as per energy audit.

title: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (WBTISRSDRE)
summary: “Reimbursement of Stamp Duty and Registration Fee” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME&T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a reimbursement of stamp duty and registration fee paid by the eligible textile sector enterprises for

title: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: State Capital Investment Subsidy (WBTISSCIS)
summary: “State Capital Investment Subsidy” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME&T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a State Capital Investment Subsidy of the fixed capital investment.

title: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Subsidy for Water conservation/ Environment Compliance (WBTISSWCEC)
summary: “Subsidy for Water Conservation/ Environment Compliance” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme by the Dept. of MSME&T , Government of West Bengal, aims to provide reimbursement of expenditure incurred by it towards the cost of captive Effluent Water Treatment Plant.

title: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Waiver of Electricity Duty (WBTISWED)
summary: “Waiver of Electricity Duty” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME&T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide waiver of electricity duty on the electricity consumed in its approved project.

title: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: Waiver of Fees for Land Conversion and Mutation (WBTISWFFLCM)
summary: “Waiver of Fees for Land Conversion and Mutation” incentives under “West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme” scheme implemented by the Dept. of MSME&T, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide a waiver of fees for conversion and mutation of the land as approved in the project.

title: Women’s Instinct for Developing and Ushering in Scientific Heights & Innovation (WIDUSHI)
summary: 'WIDUSHI' programme aims to encourage and support senior women scientists to conduct research in interdisciplinary areas of Science and Technology.

title: WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship (WISE-PDF)
summary: “WISE Post-Doctoral Fellowship” is a new programme of the Department of Science & Technology that aims to provide opportunities to women scientists & technologists between the age group of 27-60 years who want to continue their research as bench-level scientists in basic and applied sciences.

title: WISE Fellowship for Ph.D. (WISE-PHD)
summary: The "WISE Fellowship for Ph.D. (WISE-PhD)" of the Department of Science and Technology aims to provide an opportunity to carry out Doctoral research in basic and applied sciences to women scientists and technologists between the age group of 27-45 years who want to pursue research in STEM fields.

title: Women In Science and Engineering-Societal Challenges with Opportunities Fellowship (WISE-SCOPE FELLOWSHIP)
summary: The “WISE-SCOPE Fellowship” Program was started by the Department of Science & Technology, Government of India with the aims to provide opportunity to Women Scientists and Technologists who have completed Ph.D. and want to utilize their S&T knowledge and expertise for the benefit of society.

title: Women Scientist Scheme-A (WOS-A)
summary: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates to pursue research in frontier areas of science and engineering, preferably those having a break in career (minimum two years) and not having regular employment, to explore possibility of re-entry into the profession.

title: Women Scientist Scheme-B (WOS-B)
summary: A Research Grant by MoST for female candidates with break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. Women scientists who wish to apply under this scheme are required to develop their own project/proposals for scientific and technological solutions

title: Women Scientist Scheme-C (WOS-C)
summary: A scheme by MoST for female candidates with a break in their career interested in addressing societal challenges through viable S&T interventions. 1-year training is provided in Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), patent search, know-how, drafting, filing, trademarks, trade secrets, and copyright.

title: Women Self Employment Scheme (WSES)
summary: The "Women Self Employment Scheme" encourages women to become self-reliant and supports their efforts in establishing small-scale industries or trade ventures, thereby improving their economic status & promoting self-employment opportunities across the state providing them financial assistance.

title: Yatra Anudan (YA)
summary: The scheme aims to support researchers and scientists in attending international scientific workshops and other programs by providing eligible applicants with travel grants covering up to 50% of the expenses (maximum ₹25,000/-).

title: Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics and IT: Young Faculty Research Fellowships (VPHD_YFRF)
provider: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
summary: This fellowship is meant for Young Faculty having regular position at their institution and proven track record in research. Support is provisioned for 50 candidates, for an initial period of support of 2 years, extendible till 5 years based on performance review.

title: 2445: DRIVE35: Scale Up Fund
provider: Innovate UK; The Department for Business and Trade (DBT), The Advanced Propulsion Centre UK (APC)
summary: UK registered organisations can apply for a share of up to £150 million, to create scale up manufacturing facilities for zero emission vehicle technologies.

title: Access EuroHPC quantum computers through the pilot call
summary: Apply for access to Europe’s quantum computers through the EuroHPC quantum access pilot. Open to researchers exploring quantum computing and hybrid quantum and HPC work. UK applicants are eligible. No funding is provided.

title: Access EuroHPC supercomputers for research computing
summary: Apply for time on Europe’s supercomputers through EuroHPC. Access modes suit every stage, from testing code to large-scale research. UK researchers are eligible as EuroHPC members.

title: Isambard-AI and Zenith AIRR supercomputers: Gateway route
provider: UK Research and Innovation, Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC), Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC), Engineering and…
summary: Apply for 10,000 graphics processing unit hours on the Isambard-AI and Zenith supercomputers for artificial intelligence-related research and development projects. Open to UK researchers from academia, industry, or other organisations.

title: ADOPT Facilitator support grant: round 12
provider: Innovate UK; Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
summary: Farming, growing or forestry businesses based in England can apply for a grant of £2,500, to engage an external Project Facilitator to support the development of a Full ADOPT Grant application.

title: Advanced materials: highlight notice
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)
summary: EPSRC is seeking to support applications through our standard research grant scheme in the following two areas: advanced materials solutions for critical minerals in-situ and in operando materials metrology and characterisation You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding.

title: Advancing solutions for critical mineral production and recycling
provider: Natural Environment Research Council (NERC), Innovate UK, Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC), Engineering and Physical…
summary: Apply for funding for pump-priming research to explore, test and validate disruptive and transformative solutions for critical mineral extraction, processing, recovery, reprocessing, recycling or re-mining. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) funding.

title: AHRC Catalyst Awards: applicant-led mode
summary: Apply for funding to support researchers without prior experience of leading a significant research project to accelerate their trajectory as independent researchers, to unlock their potential and build leadership and convenor experience. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: AHRC Collaborate with researchers in Luxembourg: applicant-led mode
provider: Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC); Fonds National de la Recherche (FNR)
summary: Apply for funding to work with overseas researchers in Luxembourg. Submit a collaborative research grant application within the remit of AHRC and Fonds National de la Recherche (FNR). You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: AHRC Curiosity Award: applicant-led mode
summary: Apply for funding for flexible awards to fund fundamental research that leads to new research agendas, networking activity and idea generation, which enables the development of further research opportunities and new research agendas. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: AHRC Standard research grant: applicant-led mode
summary: Apply for AHRC standard research grant funding to support well-defined collaborative projects across the arts and humanities, in areas covered by our remit. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: AHRC UKRI NSF-SBE lead agency: applicant-led mode
provider: Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC); US National Science Foundation, Social, Behavioural and Economic Sciences Directorate (NSF-SBE)
summary: Apply for funding to work with overseas researchers in the Unites States (US). Submit a collaborative research grant application within the remit of AHRC and NSF-SBE. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: AHRC Working with Brazilian researchers: Applicant-led mode
provider: Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC); State of São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)
summary: Apply for funding to work with overseas researchers in the State of São Paulo, Brazil. Submit a collaborative research grant application within the remit of Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC) and State of São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP). You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: Attendance and engagement at UK sporting, cultural and heritage sites
provider: Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC); Department for Digital, Culture, Media and Sport (DCMS)
summary: Apply for funding to research the development of novel data-intensive approaches for capturing engagement data from unticketed cultural, heritage, and sporting events, activities and locations, demonstrated through a deployable tool in at least one DCMS sector. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: Battery innovation: concept development round three
provider: Innovate UK; Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST)
summary: UK registered businesses can apply for a share of up to £25 million to support innovation in battery grade material technologies for electrification. This funding is from the battery innovation programme.

title: Battery innovation: feasibility studies round three
provider: Innovate UK; Department for Business Innovation Science and Trade (BIST)
summary: UK registered businesses can apply for a share of up to £25 million to support innovation in battery grade material technologies for electrification. This funding is from the battery innovation programme.

title: Battery Innovation Programme: investor partnerships
summary: UK registered small or medium sized businesses can apply for grant funding alongside private investment from selected investor partners.

title: BBSRC Brazil pump-priming award (FAPPA)
provider: Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC); The São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)
summary: This award is for BBSRC-funded research groups to pump-prime interactions with FAPESP scientists in Brazil. Applications must be made by a project lead who is currently in receipt of BBSRC research funding.

title: International Travel Award Scheme for the Biological Sciences
provider: Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC)
summary: Apply for funding to visit international partners to initiate collaborations, prepare joint funding proposals, visit overseas facilities or attend European consortia-building events. Stays may be of up to one month in duration. You must be a current BBSRC-supported researcher to apply for funding.

title: BBSRC new investigator award: applicant-led mode
provider: Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC)
summary: Apply for funding for a research grant in any area within the remit of the Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC). You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for BBSRC funding.

title: BBSRC standard research grant: applicant-led mode
provider: Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC)
summary: Apply for funding for a research grant in any area within the remit of the Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC). You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for BBSRC funding.

title: Biodiversa+ 2026 to 2027: novel ecosystems (BiodivFuture)
provider: Natural Environment Research Council (NERC); European Biodiversity Partnership (Biodiversa+), European Commission
summary: Apply for funding to increase our understanding of novel ecosystems, their socio-ecological dynamics and consequences, and future pathways and trajectories of change. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for funding.

title: Bioinformatics and Biological Resources Fund (26BBR)
provider: Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC)
summary: Apply for funding to implement, improve or consolidate bioinformatics or biological resources in support of UK bioscience, helping to drive forwards progress in bioscience research and innovation. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for BBSRC funding.

title: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for assurance and compliance
summary: UK registered small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning solutions that monitor, test, verify or evidence compliance with requirements, standards or controls.

title: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for decision critical systems
summary: UK registered small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning solutions that support consequential judgements, recommendations or decisions.

title: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for operational systems
summary: UK registered small and medium-sized enterprises (SME) can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning solutions that perform, control or coordinate operational activity.

title: UK Obesity Research Institute: full application
provider: Medical Research Council (MRC); British Heart Foundation (BHF)
summary: Apply for funding to establish a UK Obesity Research Institute, undertaking world-leading research into the mechanistic biomedical drivers of obesity and develop targeted interventions to prevent and treat obesity and its health consequences. Applications must be led by a UK-based research organisation eligible for MRC funding.

title: UK-Singapore CRD 2026
summary: UK registered businesses can apply for a share of up to £3 million for the purpose of developing innovative proposals with Singapore. You must collaborate with at least one Singapore business applying under the equivalent Enterprise Singapore programme.

title: UKRI Enabling AI adoption across science and engineering
summary: Apply for funding for ambitious and exploratory projects bringing together AI and domain expertise. Projects will have the potential to unlock new opportunities for applying AI to research challenges in priority science and engineering disciplines. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.

title: Access EuroHPC supercomputers for AI development (AI Factories)
summary: Apply for supercomputer time to train and develop AI models through EuroHPC. Aimed at startups, small medium enterprises, industry and the public sector working on AI and data-intensive tasks. UK applicants are eligible. No funding is provided.

title: UKRI: Integration of AI/HPC with quantum computing
provider: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC), Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC)
summary: Apply for funding to deliver collaborative research projects to develop and test integration of quantum computing into high-performance computational workflows, enabling user access and widespread adoption. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for EPSRC funding.

title: UKRI-SBE lead agency opportunity
provider: Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), Biotechnology and Biological Sciences Research Council (BBSRC), Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC), UK Research and Innovation; US National…
summary: The UKRI-SBE lead agency opportunity allows UK and US-based researchers to submit a collaborative proposal that will go through a single review process. Grants are funded through existing funding programmes at the relevant lead agency.

title: UKRI Translation: AHRC Proof of Concept
summary: UKRI Translation: AHRC Proof of Concept supports arts and humanities activity that translate previously funded AHRC or UKRI projects into real world economic, societal, cultural or policy impact. This opportunity was previously known as AHRC responsive mode: follow-on funding for impact and engagement.

title: UKRI Translation: MRC Impact Acceleration Awards
summary: Apply to the MRC Impact Acceleration Award to address a single, high-risk development step and generate key data to de-risk a new medicine, medical device, diagnostic or other medical product. You must be based at a research organisation eligible for MRC funding.

title: Underground hydrogen storage demonstrator DEVEX support
summary: UK registered businesses can apply for a share of up to £1.5 million for project development studies supporting underground hydrogen storage demonstrator facilities in the UK.

title: Unlocking advanced capabilities in conservation and heritage science
summary: Apply for funding to strengthen conservation and heritage science infrastructure by building sustainable capability, improving access to nationally significant facilities and driving innovation with industry partners. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for AHRC funding.

title: Using the ‘Our Future Health’ data resource for research
provider: Medical Research Council (MRC); Our Future Health
summary: This is a pilot scheme through which the Medical Research Council (MRC) will cover data access costs for eligible researchers who are currently supported by MRC. Data is accessed through Our Future Health and you must apply for access through the ‘Our Future Health’ process.

title: Water4All 2026 call: sustainable water management
provider: Natural Environment Research Council (NERC), Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC); Water4All partnership, European Commission
summary: Apply for funding to increase our understanding, assessment, management, and governance of water across scales, from catchment to groundwater and from source to sea. Enable better decision-making for public authorities, water managers, and other stakeholders.

title: What Works Centre for a climate resilient UK
provider: Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC), UK Research and Innovation; Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra)
summary: Apply for funding to establish and lead a What Works Centre for a climate resilient UK to transform how the UK adapts to climate change. You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for Economic and Social Research (ESRC) funding.

title: Work with Brazilian researchers: NERC FAPESP lead agency
provider: Natural Environment Research Council (NERC); State of São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)
summary: This opportunity allows UK-based researchers and researchers in the State of São Paulo, Brazil to submit a collaborative application under existing NERC funding opportunities. This will go through a single review process.

title: Work with US-based researchers on environmental science: NERC-NSF lead agency
provider: Natural Environment Research Council (NERC); National Science Foundation (NSF) Directorate of Geosciences (GEO), NSF Directorate of Biological Sciences (BIO)
summary: Apply for funding to work with US-based researchers on an environmental science application. Collaborative work is governed by a lead agency agreement between NERC and NSF. The UK-based applicant must be: based at a UK research organisation eligible for NERC funding employed at lecturer (or equivalent) level or above
